assumptions: known_time_assumed: the source provides no known-time column, so each observation is treated as known the moment it applies (known_time = valid_time). Revisions and publication lags are invisible to this run.

recovery_actions.message: Supply enough observations for separated selection, calibration, and test windows.

disclosures.message: `point` is the selected model's raw output; every quantile is recentred on the median backtest residual, so `q50` differs from `point` by up to 2 (0% of the 80% interval width). Each row carries the gap as `point_bias_correction`.

3 of 3 lead times lack the 8 residuals needed to resolve their own spread; their pooled spread is widened deterministically by √lead-time (anchored at step 1, never narrowing). The schedule is a conservative default measured to slightly over-cover the mid-horizon; more folds — a longer history relative to the horizon — would let each lead measure its own.

Interval calibration pools residuals from 0 folds, including the selection folds the model was chosen on. Those residuals are optimistically small, so the interval is narrower than strict split conformal would give. Set `evaluation.pool_residuals: false` to calibrate on the held-out fold alone.
Quantile levels are limited by the residual sample: at 3 of 3 lead times, adjacent levels share an order statistic and report identical values. q10/q50/q90 are unaffected in meaning.
